mapper.select: SELECT A.DUTY, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(A.DUTY, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS DUTY_NAME, A.AFFIRM_LEVEL, B.LOCAL_NAME AS UPDATED_BY_NAME, TO_CHAR(A.UPDATE_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS UPDATE_DATE FROM SY_AFFIRM_LEVEL_SETUP A LEFT JOIN HR_EMPLOYEE B ON B.PERSON_ID = A.UPDATED_BY WHERE A.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY A.AFFIRM_LEVEL, A.DUTY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SY_AFFIRM_LEVEL_SETUP (CPNY_ID, DUTY, AFFIRM_LEVEL, CREATE_DATE, CREATED_BY, UPDATE_DATE, UPDATED_BY, ACTIVITY) VALUES (#{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{duty, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{affirmLevel, jdbcType=INTEGER}, SYSDATE, #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 1)
